evidence.title: Vercel AI Open-Sources vgpu: A TypeScript WebGPU Library for AI Agent Shaders

summary: Vercel AI has announced the open‑source release of vGPU, a TypeScript library that leverages the WebGPU API to enable developers to write GPU‑accelerated shaders for AI agents directly in the browser. The project aims to simplify on‑device AI inference and foster a community around browser‑based machine‑learning workloads.
title: Vercel AI Releases vGPU: Open-Source TypeScript WebGPU Library for Building AI Agent Shaders
